AUTHORED_SOURCE.text: Except (i) as set forth in Section 6.1(a) of the Company Disclosure Letter, (ii) as required by applicable Law, (iii) as expressly permitted by this Agreement, or (iv) with the prior written consent of Parent (which consent will not be unreasonably delayed, withheld or conditioned), from the date of this Agreement until the earlier of the Acceptance Time or the date this Agreement is terminated (the “Pre-Closing Period”), the Company shall, and shall cause its Subsidiary to, use commercially reasonable efforts (A) to carry on its business in the ordinary course of business, (B) to preserve intact its current business organization and keep available the services of its current officers and employees and (C) to preserve its relationships with customers, suppliers, partners, licensors, licensees, distributors, Governmental Bodies and any others having business dealings with it with the intention that its goodwill and ongoing business will not be materially impaired on the Closing Date.
